'''Greenlam Industries Ltd.''' is a surfacing and substrate products manufacturer based in India.<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries expects 15% revenue growth in FY24 - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/greenlam-industries-q3-earnings-revenue-growth-share-price-margins-18979071.htm |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en |date=5 February 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam to invest Rs 950 cr over 2-3 years; to enter plywood, particleboard business |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/paper-/-wood-/-glass/-plastic/-marbles/greenlam-to-invest-rs-950-cr-over-2-3-years-to-enter-plywood-particleboard-business/articleshow/88261738.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=13 December 2021}}</ref> The company provides [[laminates]], [[Plywood]], exterior & interior clads, [[Wood veneer|decorative veneers]], [[Chip-board|particle board]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Greenlam Industries Begins Commercial Production of Chipboard |url=https://www.angelone.in/news/greenlam-industries-begins-commercial-production-of-chipboard |access-date=2025-02-28 |website=www.angelone.in |language=en}}</ref> and [[Wood flooring|engineered wooden floors]] & doors for residential and commercial spaces.<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam's Plywood unit at Tindivanam goes on stream |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/greenlams-plywood-unit-at-tindivanam-goes-on-stream/article66950402.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=9 June 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Plywood companies to benefit from rise in capacity and lower input costs |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/capacity-expansion-lower-input-costs-drive-optimism-among-plywood-makers-despite-muted-q1-show/articleshow/103217510.cms |website=The Economic Times}}</ref> The company was founded in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.<ref>{{cite web |title=The future of facades: Top four design trends for 2024 |url=https://www.indulgexpress.com/life-style/home-and-decor/2024/May/06/the-future-of-facades-top-four-design-trends-for-2024 |website=Indulgexpress |language=en |date=6 May 2024}}</ref>

Greenlam Industries is listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam |url=https://www.nseindia.com/get-quotes/equity?symbol=GREENLAM |website=NSE India}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/greenlam-industries-ltd/grnlamind/538979/disclosures-insider-trading-1992/ |website=BSE India}}</ref><ref name='ET'>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries gets listed on NSE, BSE |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/greenlam-industries-gets-listed-on-nse-bse/articleshow/46434587.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=2 March 2015}}</ref>

==History==
In 1992, Greenlam Industries set up the first laminate unit at Behror and started the commercial production and export of laminates. In 2002 it started the commercial production of decorative veneers. From 2005 to 2008, Greenlam set up overseas subsidiaries in Singapore and the US.<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries Ltd Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/greenlam-industries-ltd/summary |website=India Infoline |language=en}}</ref><ref name="BT">{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries: Innovating the World of Laminates |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/business/greenlam-industries-innovating-the-world-of-laminates |website=Bru Times News |language=en}}</ref>

In 2009, Greenlam started the commercial production of the second laminate unit at Nalagarh. In 2012, the company set up a subsidiary in the UK.<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries commences commercial production at expanded facility in Nalagarh |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/greenlam-industries-commences-commercial-production-at-expanded-facility-in-nalagarh-119091101040_1.html |website=Business Standard}}</ref>

In 2014, Greenlam was demerged into a separate entity and listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).<ref name='ET'/>

In 2019, the company acquired Greenlam Decolan SA in Switzerland and Incorporated Greenlam South Limited (GSL).<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam acquires Europe-based Decolan SA |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/greenlam-acquires-europe-based-decolan-sa/articleshow/69343574.cms |website=The Times of India |date=15 May 2019}}</ref> From 2016 to 2021 The company Commissioned multiple brownfield laminate capacities and acquired 74.91% equity share capital of HG Industries Limited (formerly Himalaya Granites Limited).<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries Limited |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/greenlam-industries-limited/article7681882.ece |website=BusinessLine |language=en |date=23 September 2015}}</ref>

In 2022, Greenlam issued first listed non-convertible debentures and raised Rs. 99 cr. In the same year, the company acquired the laminate plant in Prantij, Gujarat, and raised Rs. 195 cr. via a preferential issue of equity shares.<ref name='BT'/>

In 2023, Greenlam Industries commenced enhanced capacity of the laminate unit in Prantij, Commenced a greenfield plywood unit at Tindivanam, and Commenced a greenfield laminate unit at Naidupeta.<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries launches its exclusive display centre in Kupwara |url=https://www.greaterkashmir.com/uncategorized/greenlam-industries-launches-its-exclusive-display-centre-in-kupwara/ |website=Greater Kashmir |date=23 April 2024}}</ref>

==Awards and recognitions==
*Largest Exporter in the category of Decorative Laminates 2024<ref>{{cite web |title=Press Trust Of India |url=https://www.ptinews.com/story/business/greenlam-industries-limited-awarded-as-the-largest-exporter-in-the-category-of-decorative-laminates-for-the-14th-consecutive-year/1625499 |website=www.ptinews.com}}</ref>
*Excellence award as highest exporter of Decorative Laminates for the years 2022 and 2023 from The Plastic Export Promotion Council (sponsored by the [[Ministry of Commerce and Industry (India)|Ministry of Commerce & Industry]], Department of Commerce, [[Government of India]]).<ref>{{cite web |title=Greenlam Industries receives export excellence award |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/greenlam-industries-receives-export-excellence-award-124060800328_1.html |website=Business Standard}}</ref>

extract:
Greenlam Industries Ltd. is a surfacing and substrate products manufacturer based in India. The company provides laminates, Plywood, exterior & interior clads, decorative veneers, particle board and engineered wooden floors & doors for residential and commercial spaces. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
Greenlam Industries is listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
